title.en: Bring SmartMeeting v2 Gold behavior to GreatLoveMeta course rooms
title.zh: 将 SmartMeeting v2 Gold 会议室体验迁移至 GreatLoveMeta 课程教室

purpose.en: Make member presence, private support chat and RealtimeKit media lifecycle in GreatLoveMeta course rooms match the reviewed SmartMeeting v2 Gold contract.
purpose.zh: 让 GreatLoveMeta 课程教室的会员在线状态、私密支持聊天及 RealtimeKit 媒体生命周期符合已验证的 SmartMeeting v2 Gold 规则。

en: Count signed-in members from room entry, enforce one active tab per member, and show arrivals and departures in the room ticker.
Wait for a second distinct member before beginning audio or A/V streaming; retain listener connections while a speaker is muted and retire idle provider rooms after the grace period.
Use one responsive room action row, verified speaker state and timer, and private member-to-host/co-host chat.
Provide site-owned course materials, audio notes and local text-to-speech without enabling visual sharing controls.
zh: 从进入教室起统计已登录会员、限制同一会员只开一个活跃标签页，并用滚动条显示进入和离开。
等第二位不同会员进入后才启动音频或音视频传输；静音时保留收听连接，空闲宽限期后关闭提供商房间。
使用单行响应式操作栏、经播放确认的扬声器状态与计时器，以及会员对主持团队的私密聊天。
提供本站独立的课程附件、音频笔记和本地文字转语音，同时隐藏视觉分享控制。

en: GreatLoveMeta course-room page and its presence, chat, media, material and audio-note APIs.
zh: GreatLoveMeta 课程教室页面及在线状态、聊天、媒体、附件和音频笔记接口。

en: Reuse the reviewed SmartFi adaptation of SmartMeeting v2 Gold, while preserving GreatLoveMeta locale routes and its own subscription, identity, RealtimeKit and R2 bindings.
zh: 复用已经过验证的 SmartFi 版 SmartMeeting v2 Gold 适配，同时保留 GreatLoveMeta 自己的语言路由、订阅、身份、RealtimeKit 与 R2 绑定。

en: Run fresh D1 migration and room-behavior contracts, complete site tests, lint and production build; verify the exact deployment and production Project report.
zh: 运行全新 D1 迁移及教室行为契约测试、完整站点测试、lint 与生产构建，并核对精确部署及 Project 发布记录。

en: This portfolio migration does not repeat interactive multi-device RealtimeKit acceptance on every target; automated lifecycle contracts and production availability are checked.
zh: 本次跨站迁移不逐站重复多设备 RealtimeKit 交互验收；执行自动化生命周期契约及生产可用性检查。

en: Keep GreatLoveMeta's independent brand, locale-prefixed class routes, active site subscription for audio-note eligibility, verified-email lookup, and site-specific provider title and preset namespaces.
Keep the existing team-managed Reown project, production domain allowlist and all site-owned cloud resources unchanged.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 独立品牌、带语言前缀的课程路径、本站有效订阅判断录音资格、邮箱验证查询，以及本站独立的提供商标题与预设命名空间。
保留现有团队可管理的 Reown 项目、生产域名白名单及全部本站云资源，不作改动。

rollback.en: Roll back the application commit; retain forward-only production D1 migration history and site-owned room data.
rollback.zh: 回滚应用提交；保留只能前进的生产 D1 迁移记录及本站教室数据。

productionVerification.en: Verify the exact GitHub Actions run, apex and www availability, and matching current Project release record.
productionVerification.zh: 核对精确的 GitHub Actions 运行、主域名与 www 可用性及相符的 Project 发布记录。
